messages:
elaine-sales: Heads up — Acadia Health POC is blocked. CISO said we can’t move forward until SSO + pricing concerns are addressed. They asked for an exec bridge today to resolve. Need an L1 unblock.

mike-ps: What’s the concrete ask on SSO? I thought we already agreed on SAML metadata exchange last week.

elaine-sales: Two items: 1) SSO: they need our SP metadata and expect IdP metadata back (they’re strict about ACS URL + fingerprint). Also they want websocket IP allowlist for our realtime inference gateway. 2) Pricing: they’re asking for a short-term committed throughput trial (6 weeks) with a QPS-based discount + follow-on reserved commit if it meets latency. CISO wants BYOK for keys.

jordan-eng: For SAML: we need their IdP metadata XML and the entityID. I can generate SP metadata and a quick config snippet. For websocket allowlist I need the minimal egress IP ranges and ports (443/443 w/ ALPN). Note: BYOK on Private requires Dedicated/private deployment — need Prod infra check.

sarah-cust-suc: Legal returned the security questionnaire — red flags on section 3 (key mgmt) and section 7 (data residency). Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qsa/ACADIA (internal link). They explicitly marked BYOK and audit logs as blocking.

carl-exec: I can jump on an exec bridge at 2pm PT today to help unblock procurement/legal. Who needs to be there? @mike-ps @jordan-eng @amanda-finance :+1:

elaine-sales: Please. Customer expects someone from product/infra + finance. Quick ask for finance: can you run a back-of-envelope commit pricing for 2k peak QPS, ~200 typical QPS, 6-week trial then convert option? Also include uplift for BYOK/Private infra.

amanda-finance: I can run numbers. @elaine-sales, confirm avg tokens per request and expected peak concurrency (tokens & requests). I’ll draft 3 options: usage, short-term commit, and 12-month reserved.

jordan-eng: Action items I’ll own: 1) generate SP metadata + sample ACS/EntityID. 2) produce websocket allowlist template. 3) verify Dedicated capacity & BYOK feasibility timeline (ETA 48h).

mike-ps: I’ll prep a concise one-pager for the exec bridge: SSO checklist, BYOK tradeoffs (Private vs Dedicated), and fallback (hosted-with-EKM) options.

devops-bot: Note: yesterday 2025-11-04 22:18 UTC observed 4.6% 503 on realtime pool under spike test — runbook /runbooks/realtime-pool-throttle. No ongoing incident.

elaine-sales: Thanks. Scheduling: I created a provisional calendar invite for 2pm PT and linked the bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/aca-1765409876. Please accept. We need the exec decision to land today or customer pauses POC next week.

carl-exec: Accepted. I’ll open with procurement and clarify commercial guardrails. If legal won’t sign BYOK for hosted, we move to Dedicated pilot with a 6-week reserved commit.

amanda-finance: Drafted preliminary model (sharing in thread): usage: baseline $X/token; trial commit: 25% discount on sustained QPS; reserved: additional 15% off. Need actual token estimate to finalize.

elaine-sales: Copy — I’ll post the token estimate in 15m and bring customer to the 2pm bridge. Thanks all.

mike-ps: Prep notes: keep bridge under 30m, decision options: (A) Hosted + EKM short-term, (B) Dedicated 6-week trial commit, (C) Delay POC pending legal. We’ll push for B with exec sign.

jordan-eng: Uploaded SP metadata + allowlist template to the invite and to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/aca-sso. Also starting dedicated feasibility check — will update in thread by EOD (48h).

elaine-sales: Final: customer confirmed they can join 2pm PT. See you on bridge. If anything blocks before then, ping here. :rocket:
